faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Samagra Shikshana Dharwad recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Academic Resource Person for Mental Health (Consultant) posts is 17th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Academic Resource Person for Mental Health (Consultant) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies announced for the Academic Resource Person for Mental Health (Consultant) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.A/M.Sc in Psychology, Clinical Psychology, Counseling Psychology, or a related subject to be eligible.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates need to send their applications via post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the minimum experience required for the Academic Resource Person role?
faq.answer: A minimum of 1 year of experience in the school or community mental health field is required for this position.

faq.question: Q7. What languages must the applicant know?
faq.answer: Applicants must have knowledge of Kannada, English, and basic computer skills.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves Document Verification of the submitted applications.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Samagra Shikshana Dharwad, links are provided in the 'Important Links' section.
